tolerance_rationale: Mahadasa start JDs derive from Moon longitude scaled by the Vimsottari cycle (~493 days/degree for the 18y Rahu period), amplifying the ~0.2-arcsec JPL-vs-Moshier ephemeris difference to ~39 min. Lord sequence matches exactly. 0.05 day = 72 min bound. Same root cause as vimsottari_dasha_start_date.
